E-Way Bill Monthly Trend with Growth Rates

Source: R/gst_new_functions.R
ewb_trend.Rd

Summarises ewb_data by month (optionally filtered by direction and/or state) and appends month-on-month (mom_pct) and year-on-year (yoy_pct) growth rates for both e-way bill count and assessable value.

ewb_trend(
  financial_year = NULL,
  state = NULL,
  direction = "both",
  include_mom = TRUE,
  include_yoy = TRUE
)

Arguments

financial_year

Character scalar or NULL (default).

state

Character scalar — full state name — or NULL (default, all states). Use gst_states() to see valid names.

direction

Character scalar. One of "both" (default), "intrastate", or "interstate".

include_mom

Logical. Append month-on-month growth? Default TRUE.

include_yoy

Logical. Append year-on-year growth? Default TRUE.

Value

A data.table with columns: financial_year, month_date, (if direction = "both": direction), ewb_count, assessable_value, and optionally mom_pct_count, yoy_pct_count, mom_pct_value, yoy_pct_value.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# National trend for FY 2024-25, both directions
ewb_trend(financial_year = "2024-25")

# Interstate only, Maharashtra
ewb_trend(state = "Maharashtra", direction = "interstate")

# All years, intrastate, no YoY (fewer rows of history)
ewb_trend(direction = "intrastate", include_yoy = FALSE)
} # }
